items.name: 黄尾鲴
items.fins: pectoral fins with a stout spine reaching the front of the pelvic fin origin, an anal fin with three stout spines, a forked tail fin

items.name: 赤眼鳟
items.form: an elongated body, a conical head, a blunt snout, no ventral keel, a curved mouth at the front of the head, two pairs of tiny barbels on the upper jaw, medium-sized eyes set near the tip of the snout
items.fins: a short dorsal fin without a spine, a short anal fin below and behind the dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin

items.name: 大眼华鳊
items.form: a slightly elongated body, the back slightly elevated, a small head, no barbels, large eyes, a short blunt snout, a sharp keel along the belly
items.fins: a forked tail fin

items.name: 似鳊
items.form: a relatively high back, a rounded belly, a narrow keel along the belly, a short head, a rounded blunt snout, a small downward-pointing mouth with a transverse slit, thin lips
items.fins: a dorsal fin with a smooth stout spine shorter than the head

items.name: 中华细鲫
items.fins: longer pectoral fins reaching the origin of the pelvic fins, pelvic fins reaching the anus, a relatively long anal fin without a spine, a forked tail fin with two lobes about equal in length

items.name: 麦鲮
items.form: an elongated spindle-shaped body, body depth about equal to head length

items.name: 鲈鲤
items.form: an elongated body, a large pointed head, a large mouth at the front of the head, small eyes
items.fins: a forked tail fin

items.name: 鲤鱼
items.form: no teeth in the jaws

items.name: 鲈鱼
items.form: an elongated body, a lower jaw slightly protruding
items.fins: two dorsal fins joined at the base, an anal fin with a smaller first spine and a stronger second spine

items.name: 翘嘴鲌
items.form: a slender willow-leaf-shaped body, a medium-sized head, a partial keel along the belly

items.name: 蒙古鲌
items.form: an elongated body, a pointed head, an upturned mouth, a partial keel along the belly
items.fins: a forked tail fin

items.name: 鳡鱼
items.form: a large mouth at the front of the head with the cleft reaching below the eye, a bony knob at the front of the lower jaw, small eyes
items.fins: pectoral fins not reaching the pelvic fins, pelvic fins not reaching the anal fin, a deeply forked tail fin

items.name: 刺鲃
items.form: an elongated body, a conical head, a downward-pointing mouth, two pairs of barbels
items.fins: a dorsal fin with a stout spine

items.name: 大眼鳜
items.form: an elongated body, a curved chest and belly outline, a raised head and back outline, a large slightly oblique mouth at the front of the head

items.name: 长吻鮠
items.form: a spindle-shaped body, a rounded belly, smooth skin
items.fins: a dorsal fin with two spines, an anal fin, pectoral fins with a spine, pelvic fins

items.name: 中华倒刺鲃
items.form: an elongated body, a back elevated in a curve, a conical head, eyes set on the sides of the head, a downward-pointing mouth, a blunt snout protruding slightly forward, two pairs of barbels

items.name: 银鮈
items.form: an elongated slender body
items.fins: a dorsal fin, an anal fin, pectoral fins with a spine, pelvic fins with a spine

items.name: 湖心巨鲤
items.form: a deep oval body with a rounded belly, a large blunt head, a small mouth at the front of the head, two pairs of long barbels at the mouth corners
items.fins: a long-based dorsal fin, a short anal fin, a large forked tail fin

items.name: 百斤鳡王
items.form: a long slender pike-like body, a pointed conical head, a large mouth at the front of the head, a lower jaw slightly protruding, sharp teeth
items.fins: a long dorsal fin, pointed pectoral fins, a deeply forked tail fin

items.name: 溪哥
items.form: an elongated body, a small head, a blunt rounded snout, a large oblique mouth, small bumps on the snout in males

items.name: 马口鱼
items.form: an elongated body, a hump behind the head, a rounded belly, a large rounded head, a short broad snout with a pointed tip, a large wide mouth at the front of the head sloping downward, a pair of short barbels at the corners of the mouth
items.fins: a longer anal fin in males, small bumps on the head, pectoral and anal fins in the breeding season

items.name: 宽鳍鱲
items.form: an elongated body, a pointed head, a mouth at the front of the head, no barbels
items.fins: a forked tail fin

items.name: 拉氏鱥
items.form: a mouth facing slightly downward, medium-sized eyes
items.fins: a short small dorsal fin, oval pectoral fins, a slightly concave tail fin

items.name: 小鳈
items.form: a small slightly elongated body, a slightly arched back, a small head, a short blunt snout, a very small downward-pointing mouth, small eyes, a pair of very fine barbels at the corners of the mouth
items.fins: a dorsal fin without spines, short pectoral fins with rounded rear edges, pelvic fins with rounded rear edges, an anal fin with a flat outer margin, a shallowly forked tail fin

items.name: 黑鳍鳈
items.form: a small elongated body, a rounded belly, a rather small head

items.name: 棒花鱼
items.form: a rounded posterior body, a raised back, a slightly rounded forward-projecting snout, thick developed lips, small eyes set high on the head

items.name: 似鮈
items.fins: long pectoral fins

items.name: 间下鱵
items.form: an elongated slender body, a lower jaw extended into a beak about as long as the head, a short small upper jaw with a triangular tip, fine teeth on the jaws
items.fins: a dorsal fin, an anal fin set opposite and behind the dorsal fin, short pectoral fins, short small pelvic fins, a shallowly forked tail fin with the lower lobe slightly longer than the upper

items.name: 光唇鱼
items.form: an elongated body, a downward-pointing curved mouth, a straight front edge of the lower jaw, two pairs of barbels
items.fins: a dorsal fin with a spine bearing fine serrations on its rear edge

items.name: 缨口鳅
items.form: a slender body, a blunt rounded snout, a downward-pointing mouth with fleshy fringed lips, barbels at the corners of the mouth
items.fins: pectoral and pelvic fins spread out, a low dorsal fin

items.name: 褐鳟
items.form: an elongated spindle-shaped body, a medium-sized head, a short blunt snout, a mouth at the front of the head
items.fins: a single dorsal fin, a slightly forked tail fin

items.name: 溪石斑
items.form: an elongated body, a small head, a blunt rounded snout, a downward-pointing mouth with a horny lower lip, barbels at the corners of the mouth

items.name: 唇䱻
items.form: a rather large head, large eyes, a downward-pointing horseshoe-shaped mouth
items.fins: a soft dorsal fin, pectoral fins without a spine, pelvic fins set slightly behind the dorsal fin origin, a rather long anal fin reaching almost to the base of the tail fin, a deeply forked tail fin

items.name: 白甲鱼
items.form: a spindle-shaped body, a short head, a blunt forward-projecting snout, a rather wide curved mouth, a naked lower jaw with a sharp horny front edge

items.name: 山女鳟
items.form: an elongated body, relatively large eyes, a protruding beak-like snout, a mouth at the front of the head, a gap between the upper and lower jaws
items.fins: a dorsal fin set far back, short small pectoral fins, pelvic fins set far from the pectoral fins, a crescent-shaped tail fin

items.name: 台湾铲颌鱼
items.form: a moderately elongated body
items.fins: a dorsal fin, an anal fin, pectoral fins, pelvic fins

items.name: 中华刺鳅
items.form: a pointed elongated head, a long pointed snout tip, round large protruding eyes, a spine in front of the eye, spines along the back
items.fins: dorsal, anal and tail fins joined continuously

items.name: 福建小鳔鮈
items.form: an elongated body, a small head, a blunt rounded snout, a downward-pointing mouth, a pair of barbels at the corners of the mouth

items.name: 溪灵·金线鲃
items.form: an elongated body, a pointed slender snout, eyes set at the middle of the head, sensory pores on the head
items.fins: a forked tail fin, a dorsal fin with a thick bony spine bearing fine serrations on its rear edge and a soft tip, a slightly concave outer margin on the dorsal fin

items.name: 麦穗鱼
items.form: a small upward-pointing mouth, thin lips, no barbels
items.fins: a soft dorsal fin without spines, set slightly behind the pelvic fin origin, short small pectoral and pelvic fins, a forked tail fin

items.name: 白条
items.form: an elongated body, a slightly arched back, a small pointed head, an upward-pointing mouth, no barbels
items.fins: a short dorsal fin with a spine, a deeply forked tail fin

items.name: 鲫鱼
items.form: a deep body, a slightly arched back, a small head, a short blunt snout, a mouth at the front of the head, no barbels
items.fins: a long dorsal fin with a stout serrated spine, a deeply forked tail fin

items.name: 鳑鲏
items.form: a small body, a small mouth, no barbels at the corners of the mouth, no ventral keel
items.fins: a forked tail fin
